post.summary: Set up the first site of a disaster recovery pair
post.description: Writes the GS_DR_* variables (in `gluesync-dr.env`, read by Core Hub only) and the compose changes a DR site needs, answers 202 with the pairing code for the second site, then recreates Chronos and Core Hub. This site keeps its data and starts active. The pairing code contains the shared secret of the pair, and the operator token is shown only here: keep both private.

nodeId.description: Id of the site: 1 to 32 characters, lower-case letters, digits and "-", starting with a letter or digit

url.description: Core Hub base URL of the site, http:// or https:// host:port with no path. The control port and the replication sink are on the same host.

post.summary: Show the pairing code of the first site again
post.description: Rebuilds the pairing code from `gluesync-dr.env` of this site, with the content `setup/first` returned: this site is the first, the peer is the joiner. For when the code was lost, for example because the UI session ended when Core Hub restarted. It is a POST so that it is never cached or logged as a URL, and the answer is not cached. The code contains the shared secret of the pair: keep it private. Only the first site of a pair set up by this Conductor can answer: any other host is answered with 409.
